call_points.text: Consolidated EBITDA margin can be maintained in the high teens, management said.
Net debt to equity is 0.2x and management does not expect to go up to 1x.
Commodity cost pass-through has a one-quarter lag; management expects normalisation this quarter.
Antolin interiors margin improved from 7%-8% to early teens and management hopes for mid-teens.
Manufacturing volumes grew 12-14% and SPR grew over 16%, outgrowing the industry.
Takahata phase-four expansion has started; new business revenue expected early next year.
EMFi doubled sales last year after commissioning the Coimbatore capacity in December; full-year benefit expected now.
Net debt was about ₹550 Cr as of June 2026.
Fundraise is progressing as per target; use between acquisitions and debt repayment not split.
Exports to Europe, the US and the Middle East remain weak and have not recovered.
Management declined to give segment revenue/EBITDA break-up or wage-cost impact for the quarter.
The company is planning a QIP of INR 1,000 crores to fund future organic and inorganic growth.
